notes: Product review batch 7 (v1.11.38): five P3 ideas (P3-8–P3-12). P3-8: timed exam simulation — pick an exam (nearest first), run it with a countdown from its real duration, per-subject correct/wrong/unanswered counters with live raw scores (wrong −1/3), and on finish the result is saved through the existing exam-result path, marked «شبیه‌سازی» (a real result is only overwritten after a confirm). While a simulation runs, switching to another tab asks first — no peeking at other tabs' content mid-exam. P3-9: daily goal + streak — a per-day target (useful minutes or boxes) shown on the «امروز» tab with a progress bar; consecutive days meeting it count as a streak (default target 8 useful hours). The goal only counts and displays — it never changes the programme or blocks a box. P3-10: server.py split into real layers — backup, repository and Google-sync code now live in srv/backup.py, srv/repository.py and srv/google_sync.py, routes stay in server.py; no behaviour change (BUG-019 three-phase push/sync and BUG-002 deep-merge intact). P3-11: data layer Repository — all state/testbook/programme/calendar-config/OAuth/push-state reads and writes go through srv/repository.py (load_state reads without writing, migrate_state writes once when needed); no behaviour change. P3-12: one date module + one subject/type reference table — all Jalali conversions go through jalaliParts/jalaliLabel in i18n.js and all subject/type lookups through the SUBJECTS table (16 rows, core/general types); examDateText stays the live jalaliParts computation. Known totals unchanged: حسابان 3489, شیمی 3000; گسسته and فیزیک have none (2110 not reintroduced). The 1.11.18 examDateText live-computation fix, the 1.11.30 tick dates and Dey builder, the 1.11.27 delete-retry fix, and the 1.11.34 drill-down are untouched.
